findings.description: The instance user-data embeds an AWS access key ID and secret access key. These credentials are stored in Terraform state and launch metadata/user-data and can be extracted by anyone with access to them, enabling unauthorized AWS API access.
TCP port 22 is open to 0.0.0.0/0. The attached instance is placed in a public subnet with a default route to an Internet Gateway, making remote SSH reachable from any Internet host.

The EBS data volume does not set encrypted = true or a KMS key. Its contents, and the snapshot created from it, may therefore be stored unencrypted at rest unless account-level defaults happen to enforce encryption.
The S3 bucket receiving VPC flow logs has no server-side encryption configuration. Sensitive network telemetry may be stored without an explicitly enforced encryption-at-rest control.
